name.fr-FR: Explication de quelques difficultés sur les prières de la messe, à un nouveau catholique
name.en-US: Explanation of Some Difficulties on the Prayers of the Mass, for a New Catholic
name.pt-BR: Explicação de algumas dificuldades sobre as orações da missa, a um novo católico

description.fr-FR: Réponse de Bossuet à un protestant converti qui s’embarrassait de plusieurs prières du canon et de l’ordinaire de la messe : le sacrifice, l’oblation, l’intercession des saints et la prière pour les morts. Publié en 1689. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s answer to a converted Protestant troubled by several prayers of the canon and the ordinary of the Mass: the sacrifice, the oblation, the intercession of the saints and prayer for the dead. Published in 1689. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Resposta de Bossuet a um protestante convertido que se embaraçava com várias orações do cânon e do ordinário da missa: o sacrifício, a oblação, a intercessão dos santos e a oração pelos mortos. Publicado em 1689. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XVII, page 002. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
